statements.statement: Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The patient has recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
The clinical indication documents concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The service was ordered for extended ambulatory assessment to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity
The service was ordered to guide anticoagulation and rate control strategies
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial concerns missing prior authorization
